title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Aaaahhh! You want me to stay by your side? I can barely keep my heart in my chest!

title: Talk 1
original: Fascinating...

title: Talk 2
original: Don't mind me, just continue with your work.

title: Talk 3
original: Hmm? What am I looking at? Why, you, of course!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: If that's what you ask, Doctor, I will do what it takes to become stronger.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Heheh... You don't need to worry about any ambushes or assassination attempts. Because I'll aaalways be here with you.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Are you finally... a little bit interested in me now? Well, I've always been a big bit interested in you.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Thanks for taking such good care of me these days. By my knighthood of Kazimierz, I hereby pledge to repay your kindness with my life—huh? You're not used to me talking this way? But I'm an honest-to-goodness knight. Surely I can improvise a speech or two.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Ever since I was taken away to Kazimierz, it's rare for someone to be so kind to me. So, if you don't mind, Doctor... I, Gravel—no, I Senomy, on my honor as a knight, shall serve you always at your side.

title: Idle
original: When I'm here with you, don't you feel your heart racing?

title: Onboard
original: Mmmwah. Hm? What's wrong? Your face is beet red. That's just how I say hello. Don't think too much about it. Anyway, I'm Gravel, a knight of Kazimierz. It's a pleasure. Heheh.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Are you the one who comes up with all the Rhodes Island's battle tactics, Doctor? Oh~ that's even more intriguing.

title: Promotion 1
original: You think I'm doing well, Doctor? Yaay!

title: Promotion 2
original: This means you need me, doesn't it? Heheh.

title: Added to Squad
original: You want to go together? Hehe...

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Oh~ You chose me!

title: Depart
original: I'll come with you~

title: Begin Operation
original: Hehehe...

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Hmm?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Any orders for me?

title: Deployment 1
original: This is the place~

title: Deployment 2
original: Surely a good spot.

title: In Battle 1
original: I am your shadow.

title: In Battle 2
original: Hehehe...

title: In Battle 3
original: You really think you'll get away?

title: In Battle 4
original: Gather up, my rats!

title: 4-star Result
original: Of course the Doctor's tactics are flawless~

title: 3-star Result
original: My blade hasn't even been stained red yet... hehe...

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Run all you like, let's see how far you can get.

title: Operation Failure
original: Sorry... did I... mess up again...?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Hmm, looks like there's a lot of good hiding places here in this room~

title: Tap
original: Hehehe...

title: Trust Tap
original: Yes. I'm right here, always and forever.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor. Give me your hand—mmmwah—hm? What are you so surprised for? Kissing the hands of those we've sworn to protect is how us knights of Kazimierz celebrate the New Year, you know. You've never heard of it? Sounds like you need to pay a little more attention.

title: Greeting
original: How are you today, Doctor?

title: Birthday
original: How daring of you to tear open a gift package with no sender, Doctor. With that little caution, trouble's bound to come knocking sooner or later~ Actually, rather than being on my toes all day as your bodyguard, how about I just open these up for you, hm?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Doctor, does it ever keep you up at night... that you might never find any trace of your past again? Whenever I step out onto Rhodes Island's deck, I wonder, would walking away from here bring me any closer to my forgotten memories?... Say, Doctor, don't you know you're supposed to console me, when I bring down the mood like this?
